title: DSH plugin market
description: Plugin index for the DeepSeek Harness desktop client. Generate or extend an entry with `node tools/release.mjs --index --repo <git url> --write <this file>`.

plugins.name: dsh-client-ui-workspace-suite
plugins.title: dsh-client-ui-workspace-suite
plugins.description: Workspace suite for the DSH Web client: an explorer-style picker (browse, inline folder creation, path input, enter-which-workspace chooser), a nested workspace tree with collapse-all and cascade delete, a per-workspace overview page (subtree token totals, expanded session tree, turn jumps, dependencies card, README), and a root-level conversation workspace menu.
